description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git notes fanout restructuring. It includes test cases that verify the creation, deletion, and fanout transitions of notes attached to commits, using commands like git diff-tree, git notes, git log, and git ls-tree.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has a specific fanout layout by analyzing its hex-encoded directory structure.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Determines if a note related to a specific commit has a particular fanout configuration after modification.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a given commit have a specified fanout.
